review.reason: The change replaces a generic or less actionable error message with a specific, remediation-oriented message ('Generate a new API key...') when Resend OAuth authentication fails. P1.F1.H1 demonstrates this behavioral change in the warehouse configuration or API response path. P1.F2.H1 updates the corresponding unit test to assert the new message, preserving coverage. observations.behavior: Replaces the error message returned when OAuth authentication fails, while retaining the OAuth-specific check; also updates the corresponding test assertion to check for the new message rather than the exact old string.
